newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina estimates July revenues up 9.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentina estimates July revenues up 9.9 pct.

text.p: Argentine government fiscal revenues should grow by an estimated 9.9 percent in July compared to the same month last year, when it was $3.91 billion, an Economy Ministry official said Thursday
"The main reason for the rise we are seeing is the increase in economic activity," Under Secretary for Tax Policy Guillermo Rodriguez Use told reporters.
Other factors in the rise were increases in income tax and fuel levies, as well as improved collection administration, Rodriguez Use said.
July revenues should exceed this June's by 6.1 percent, he said.
